messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: log( probability = 0)
parts:
Hi Phil,

When I am playing with mirt, I found one potential problem in the MH sampler (makedraws code):

total_1 <- rowSums(fulldata * log(itemtrace1)) + log_den1

It may encounter probability = 0, so log(0)=-Inf and then total_1=NA.  It will return error.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: log( probability = 0)
parts:
Not sure I follow, why would this ever have probability 0? The item trace-lines are bounded to fall within 1e-16 < P < 1-1e-16, so the log is always possible.

Phil
